messages:
Maria: Heads up — we need to align runtime/infra metrics before the rollout next week. specifically: OTel -> Prom label mapping, naming conventions, and cardinality guidance for dashboards/quotas.
Kevin: +1. can we keep a small core label set (service, model, model_version, route, region, deployment) and then optional low-cardinality extras?
Jasmin: agree. customer_id is high-card — avoid as a label on Prom metrics. use customer_tier or hashed_customer_id only for debug/ephemeral dashboards.
Sophie: for rollout UX dashboards we need rollout_stage (baseline, canary, ramp, prod) and rollout_id. rollout_id can be high-card but we only include it on a dedicated rollout index, not main metrics.
Raj: quick mapping proposal: OTel resource.service.name -> service, resource.region -> region, span.attributes.model.name -> model, attribute.model.version -> model_version. keep label names snake_case.
Frank: tiny nit: metric naming prefix should be "redwood_" for infra-owned metrics (e.g., redwood_inference_request_duration_seconds) to avoid collisions.
Kevin: agree on prefix. also stick to Prom histogram suffixes _bucket/_count/_sum for latency.
Maria: putting a short example we can use as a template for dashboards and alerts:
```
# Prom example
redwood_inference_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service="inference",model="gptj-6b",model_version="v1.2",route="chat",region="us-west-2",deployment="hosted"} 42
redwood_inference_requests_total{service="inference",model="gptj-6b",route="chat",status="ok",region="us-west-2"} 1234
redwood_quota_tokens_used{service="inference",customer_tier="pro",region="eu-central-1"} 98765
```
Jasmin: +1. also add label cardinality guidance inline: model and model_version are medium-cardinality, route and deployment low, region low. customer_tier low. avoid using customer_id or user_id as labels.
Sophie: dashboards: create one per route with these panels: p50/p95 latency, request rate, error rate, quota burn rate, rollout stage breakdown. reuse templated variables for service/model/region.
Raj: telemetry question — do we want to attach kv-cache_hit boolean as a label? that doubles metric series count. maybe emit separate cache_hit_count and cache_miss_count metrics instead.
Frank: +1 on separate counters. cheaper in Prom and easier to alert on cache regressions.
Kevin: regarding OTel -> Prom export, we should map semantic conventions to our label names in the exporter transform. I'll draft the config.
Maria: action items: Kevin will draft exporter mapping + example config (PR). Jasmin will write cardinality section and label whitelist. Sophie will make dashboard template in grafana org. Frank will add metric name prefixing guide to style doc. Raj will prototype cache metrics change. I'll coordinate and make a short RFC doc in docs/metrics.
Jasmin: can we also add a short test harness for verifying label cardinality? e.g., synthetic traffic to run through and report series count.
Kevin: good idea — I'll add a smoke test to the CI job for runtime images.
metrics-bot: deploy-bot: grafana/dashboard/update succeeded for "rollout-template-v1" :white_check_mark:
Maria: thanks all. I'll post a summary + links to PRs once Kevin's draft is up. please flag any hard blocker by EOD so we can keep the rollout timeline. :thumbsup:
